## Draft reply

Hi Ada,

Thank you for your note. I'm glad to hear from you about collecting your necklace with the new clasp.

I work by appointment, so the easiest way is to book a Pick up appointment here: https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule.php?owner=16919152

It takes about 10 minutes, and you can choose a time that suits you. I'll check on my side that everything is in order for your visit. If you have any trouble booking, call me at 206-605-1510 or reply here.

The showroom is at The Winslow Showroom, Harbor Square, 752 Winslow Way East, Bainbridge Island.

Warmly,
Alina

## Intake note for Alina

- **Reported issue:** Ada says you emailed yesterday that her necklace, with a new clasp, is ready. She wants to book a collection time.
- **Not known yet:** I can't see your records or the email, so I haven't confirmed the necklace is ready or that the email was sent.
- **Decisions for you:** Check the necklace is ready before Ada comes in. Edit the reply if it isn't.
- **Suggested appointment:** Pick up (10 min). Ada says the studio told them the piece is ready.
